cases.query: Treat the values 'off' and 'n' as false as well, case-insensitively, and update the docstring to list every value that is treated as false.

Add a new built-in CLI command flask config that prints the loaded application's configuration as JSON, masking the values of any key containing SECRET, PASSWORD, TOKEN or KEY as ***. It must appear in flask --help, be covered by a test, and be documented alongside the other built-in commands.
Assemble context while pinning the user's selected range and explicit file and symbol references ahead of automatic results, within the token budget.
Rank relevant workspace files using BM25 identifier terms, symbol and path boosts, and nearby tests, docs, and imports.
When Stop arrives during an in-flight editor write, wait for settlement before terminal done, and do not start retry or fallback while tools remain unsettled.
Require approval before an agent command runs, protect the checkout from writes, constrain cwd to the workspace, and kill the process group on cancellation.
Render approval and status control events immediately in the webview while text deltas are coalesced, preserving their event order.
Let the user accept selected diff hunks while binding each choice to the proposal base hash and retaining exact undo.
Build the prompt with the ranked context shortlist and gather more context through the MCP tool when evidence is missing.
Pass context and command settings from the extension Workbench into the turn request and preserve the protocol version.
Load agent JSON templates, build primary and fallback TrueForge agents, and set up model provider configuration.
Index visible source files while respecting gitignore, credentials, generated directories, file limits, and unreadable file reporting.
Connect the panel and inline edit commands to a turn controller that streams sequenced events from the TrueForge harness.
